objective: Test whether a generic arithmetic meta-family can select a behaviorally novel representation primitive absent from the existing 8,626-feature base ontology, then transfer the frozen primitive to distinct tasks.
baseOntology: The V2/V3 8,626-feature Boolean grammar built from BIT, small residue predicates, popcount thresholds, negation and depth-2 AND/OR/XOR.
targetBehavior: Parity of prime-factor count with multiplicity.
selector: Discovery train accuracy, discovery validation accuracy, lower declared complexity, lexical ID.

split.law: Transfer labels and all held-out labels are excluded from primitive selection.

falsifier: Selected primitive has an exact equivalent in the base ontology on the declared preflight fixture.
Discovery fails accuracy or improvement threshold.
Fewer than two transfers meet both transfer thresholds.
Held-out or transfer labels influence primitive selection.
promotionBoundary: A pass supports a narrow software claim: UberBond can admit and reuse a finite-fixture behaviorally novel primitive selected from a declared meta-family. It does not prove open-ended ontology invention, autonomous mathematics, scientific discovery, or general intelligence.
